briefing.headline: Stop re-reading the same Datadog/Amazon wall — today's leverage is fintech-domain PMM at Stripe plus three under-scored roles the keyword filter buried.
briefing.focus: Spend the first 10 minutes on Anthropic's Product Marketing Operations Manager and Stripe's GTM PMM (Commerce) — both are the rare intersection of PMM craft, funnel/attribution ownership, and a company that sponsors; Stripe also lets you sell six years of banking/fintech as domain expertise instead of a career pivot. Next 10 on the keyword-underrated set: Workday's Paid Media & ABX Campaign Manager (ABX is literally ABM, scored 60) and Figma's Audience & Messaging PMM (positioning + segmentation, US-wide). Skip the Datadog and Amazon AWS reqs you've now seen 5-9 days running — if they were going to land, they'd have landed; the one Amazon exception is the numbered 'AMZ####' Business Analyst III reqs, which are PERM-style postings and the clearest sponsorship signal on this list.

ranked.why: Keyword score of 78 is nonsense — PMM + ops + funnel instrumentation is the exact center of your resume, and Anthropic sponsors and is scaling GTM fast.
Only role here where your six years in banking/fintech is domain credibility rather than a pivot story; US-remote and Stripe files H-1Bs at volume.
Positioning, messaging, and segmentation is your literal skill list, posted 8/11, and the 'United States' location makes Boston workable — worth the effort of a tailored writing sample.
'ABX' is ABM with a different vowel — scored 60 because the filter didn't know that; Workday is a top-tier sponsor and this is specialist-level, not senior.
Technical PMM for an analytics portfolio is the cleanest bridge between your STEM MBA and your B2B marketing history; Amazon sponsorship is a formality.
Brand new to the list, and the 'AMZ9706885' req number means this is a PERM/immigration-linked posting — the single strongest sponsorship signal in today's batch.
Enterprise integrated campaigns is demand gen plus ABM under a different title; fresh posting, individual-contributor level, and Anthropic is hiring GTM aggressively.
Scored 60 only because the JD came through as raw HTML — stablecoins/payments PMM is the highest-leverage fintech-to-tech translation on this page.
Highest ATS score of any PMM role and genuinely mid-level, but databases is the most crowded internal AWS PMM lane — apply, don't wait on it.
B2B performance marketing at specialist level is level-correct and Adobe is an established sponsor; the 60 score is purely a missing JD, not a weak match.
Fresh 8/14 analyst req with real SQL/forecasting scope, but the JD text says 'Sr. Business Analyst' — expect the bar to sit above the posted title.
Core-product PMM at Anthropic is broader and less technical than the AWS variants — an 84 keyword score badly understates a strong narrative fit.
6sense sells the ABM platform you already run — remote-US and the one place your ABM history is the product, though a ~1,000-person company is a softer sponsorship bet.
True B2B PMM inside Amazon with procurement buyers who look like your banking clients; prev 5 means it's aging, so this is the last week to bother.
Lending/capital lifecycle marketing at Stripe maps directly to fintech product marketing, remote-US, and lifecycle is adjacent to the funnel metrics you own.
Never surfaced before and another numbered PERM-style Amazon req; Las Vegas is a relocation ask, which is exactly why competition is thinner.
Best-fitting Datadog PMM req and NY/SF-based with a Boston office in the org, but you've seen it three runs — send it today or cut it.
Associate-level GTM ops is the correct rung for the analyst lane and Datadog hires MBAs into it, though prev 5 says you keep deferring it.
Associate-titled demand gen, US-remote, field programs — level-appropriate and fast to apply, with sponsorship the main open question.
Enterprise AI PMM at Nvidia scored 60 purely on an empty JD; Nvidia is one of the most reliable H-1B sponsors in tech and enterprise AI is not GPU-engineering deep.
Brand new, NYC, and AI/data partnerships field marketing is a genuinely interesting lane — but Similarweb is Israel-HQ mid-cap, so verify they sponsor US roles first.
Marketing-analytics-for-demand-gen is your ideal analyst role, but nine prior recommendations and a 7/31 post date mean this one has already gone cold.
Titled marketing analyst and remote-US, which is the bullseye of lane two — demoted only because nine runs of no action says you've decided against it.
Posted today and campaign management is squarely in your wheelhouse; Autodesk sponsors, but 'Forma' is a construction-tech niche you'd be learning cold.
MongoDB sponsors and lifecycle/PLG growth is a real fit, but developer-audience marketing is the weakest part of your story and prev 6 shows it's stalling.
One of the only actual Boston reqs and specialist-level, but brand marketing sidelines the funnel and ABM work that makes you differentiated.
Netflix Ads PMM in NY scored 60 on an empty JD — a B2B advertiser-facing role at a huge sponsor is worth 5 minutes to check the actual level.
Remote GTM business ops with strong ATS alignment, but 'Manager' at Samsara implies more forecasting ownership than you've held and prev 5 says it isn't converting.
GTM strategy and planning uses your funnel-metrics muscle, though no Boston or remote option and Gong expects sales-ops depth you'd be stretching to claim.
Fintech-adjacent demand gen in NY is a decent domain match, but a brand-new legal product line at a company post-layoffs is a shakier landing spot.
Boston and B2B, but a 97 keyword score has flattered a fairly junior specialist role for nine straight runs with no result — the fit score is doing the work here, not the role.
Boston-based analyst work is scarce enough to keep on the list, but nine prior pushes and a consumer-hardware ops focus with unclear sponsorship put it last.
A perfect 100 on a two-word title and no location flexibility — San Mateo-only, vague scope, and a company with a documented culture record makes this the most over-scored row today.
